record.field: Log Corrective Workshop Ticket & Shrinkage Scrap

for record in records: if record.x_leakage_status != 'leakage_alert': raise UserError("Maintenance tickets can only be generated for Leakage Alert records.")
# 1. Identify or link equipment for vehicle equipment = env['maintenance.equipment'].search([ ('x_linked_vehicle_id', '=', record.x_vehicle_id.id) ], limit=1)
if not equipment: cat_ref = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.maintenance_cat_fleet_truck', raise_if_not_found=False) team_ref = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.maintenance_team_otjiwarongo', raise_if_not_found=False) equipment = env['maintenance.equipment'].create({ 'name': "%s - Tanker Manifold & Meter Rig" % (record.x_vehicle_id.name or 'NFD Tanker'), 'x_asset_category': 'fleet_truck', 'x_linked_vehicle_id': record.x_vehicle_id.id, 'category_id': cat_ref.id if cat_ref else False, 'maintenance_team_id': team_ref.id if team_ref else False, })
# 2. Create Corrective Maintenance Request for Otjiwarongo Workshop plate = record.x_vehicle_id.license_plate or 'N/A' veh_name = record.x_vehicle_id.name or 'Tanker' ticket_name = "URGENT: Inspect Tanker Manifold/Delivery Meter for Fuel Leakage - %s (%s)" % (veh_name, record.x_name) desc = ( "AUTOMATED LEAKAGE ALERT TRIGGERED:
" "- Dispatch Log: %s
" "- Tanker: %s (License: %s)
" "- Driver: %s
" "- Receiving Client: %s
" "- Depot Loaded: %.2f L
" "- Delivered Reading: %.2f L
" "- Thermal Variance Allowed: %.2f L
" "- NET DISCREPANCY: %.2f L (Exceeds 50L Safety Limit)
" "- Seals Affixed: %s

" "ACTION REQUIRED BY OTJIWARONGO WORKSHOP:
" "1. Pressure test bottom-loading manifold and foot valves.
" "2. Calibrate onboard digital flow meter.
" "3. Inspect discharge hoses and vapor recovery connections for weeping." ) % ( record.x_name, veh_name, plate, record.x_driver_id.name if record.x_driver_id else 'N/A', record.x_customer_id.name if record.x_customer_id else 'N/A', record.x_depot_loaded_liters or 0.0, record.x_truck_meter_delivered_liters or 0.0, record.x_temp_allowance_liters or 0.0, record.x_net_variance_liters or 0.0, record.x_compartment_seal_numbers or 'N/A' )
team_ref = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.maintenance_team_otjiwarongo', raise_if_not_found=False) ticket = env['maintenance.request'].create({ 'name': ticket_name, 'equipment_id': equipment.id, 'maintenance_team_id': team_ref.id if team_ref else False, 'maintenance_type': 'corrective', 'priority': '3', 'description': desc, 'x_asset_category': 'fleet_truck', 'x_site_partner_id': record.x_customer_id.id if record.x_customer_id else False, 'x_dispatch_log_id': record.id, 'x_service_agreement_type': 'internal_fleet', }) record['x_maintenance_request_id'] = ticket.id
# 3. Create Stock Scrap / Shrinkage Entry loss_loc = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.location_fuel_shrinkage', raise_if_not_found=False) if not loss_loc: loss_loc = env['stock.location'].search([('name', 'ilike', 'Shrinkage')], limit=1)
src_loc = record.x_source_location_id or env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.location_tank_1_diesel', raise_if_not_found=False)
try: scrap = env['stock.scrap'].create({ 'product_id': record.x_fuel_product_id.id, 'scrap_qty': max(1.0, record.x_net_variance_liters or 1.0), 'product_uom_id': record.x_fuel_product_id.uom_id.id if record.x_fuel_product_id.uom_id else False, 'location_id': src_loc.id if src_loc else False, 'scrap_location_id': loss_loc.id if loss_loc else False, 'origin': "Leakage Discrepancy %s" % record.x_name, }) try: scrap.action_validate() except Exception: pass record['x_scrap_id'] = scrap.id except Exception: pass
record['x_state'] = 'investigation'

tank1 = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.location_tank_1_diesel', raise_if_not_found=False) tank2 = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.location_tank_2_ulp95', raise_if_not_found=False) workshop = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.location_workshop_store', raise_if_not_found=False)
p_diesel = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.product_diesel_50ppm', raise_if_not_found=False) p_ulp = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.product_ulp_95', raise_if_not_found=False) p_oil = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.product_oil_15w40', raise_if_not_found=False) p_grease = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.product_grease_ep2', raise_if_not_found=False) p_filter = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.product_scania_filter_kit', raise_if_not_found=False) p_seal = env.ref('nfd_petrosol_demo.product_tanker_seal_kit', raise_if_not_found=False)
items = [ (p_diesel, tank1, 485000.0), (p_ulp, tank2, 165000.0), (p_oil, workshop, 45.0), (p_grease, workshop, 60.0), (p_filter, workshop, 25.0), (p_seal, workshop, 30.0), ] for p, loc, q in items: if p and loc: quant = env['stock.quant'].search([('product_id', '=', p.id), ('location_id', '=', loc.id)], limit=1) if not quant: env['stock.quant'].create({ 'product_id': p.id, 'location_id': loc.id, 'quantity': q, }) else: quant['quantity'] = q
